title: Esther’s Wise Plan
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders before she acts, and tonight Esther waits for just the right moment to speak to the king: Wren holds her big news until Dad finishes his phone call, so he can truly listen.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she knows the wisdom of waiting for the right moment. In Wren’s world today: Wren wanted to tell Dad her big news, but he was on an important phone call. She really, really wanted to interrupt! Instead, she waited patiently, and when he finished, she shared her news — and he could truly listen. Just like Esther waited for the right time, Wren learned that patience makes our words land better.
